senses.example: Min gamle computer gik agurk i går.
senses.example_translation: My old computer went crazy yesterday.

senses.example: Min telefon gik itu, da jeg tabte den på gulvet.
senses.example_translation: My phone broke when I dropped it on the floor.

senses.example: Jeg tror, at han ombestemmer sig i morgen.
senses.example_translation: I think he will change his mind tomorrow.

senses.text: to flip a coin (to decide something)
senses.example: Vi slog plat og krone om den sidste kage.
senses.example_translation: We tossed a coin for the last cake.

senses.example: Mødet gik for sig i kantinen.
senses.example_translation: The meeting took place in the canteen.

senses.example: Motion gør godt for helbredet.
senses.example_translation: Exercise is good for health.

senses.example: Du skal se dig for, når du går over gaden.
senses.example_translation: You have to watch out when you cross the street.

senses.example: Hun ser sig om i det nye hus.
senses.example_translation: She looks around the new house.

senses.example: Hun ser op mod himlen.
senses.example_translation: She looks up at the sky.

senses.example: Mange børn ser op til deres forældre.
senses.example_translation: Many children look up to their parents.

senses.example: Tag for dig af salaten, der er nok.
senses.example_translation: Help yourself to the salad, there is enough.

senses.example: Hun tager over, når chefen er syg.
senses.example_translation: She takes over when the boss is ill.

senses.example: Hvad vil du tage dig for i weekenden?
senses.example_translation: What are you going to do this weekend?

senses.example: Han blev stående ved døren i lang tid.
senses.example_translation: He remained standing at the door for a long time.

senses.text: to be going well (of affairs, relationships)
senses.example: Det står godt til med deres ægteskab.
senses.example_translation: Their marriage is doing well.

senses.example: Det siger sig selv, at børn har brug for kærlighed.
senses.example_translation: It goes without saying that children need love.

senses.text: to be on the verge of
senses.example: Jeg var lige ved at falde på isen.
senses.example_translation: I almost fell on the ice.

senses.example: Hun gør brug af sin erfaring i det nye job.
senses.example_translation: She makes use of her experience in her new job.

senses.example: Eleverne deler sig op i mindre grupper til projektarbejde.
senses.example_translation: The pupils split up into smaller groups for project work.

senses.text: to be located, to hang out
senses.example: Mange unge holder til i parken om sommeren.
senses.example_translation: Many young people spend time in the park in the summer.

senses.text: to endure, to put up with
senses.example: Jeg kan ikke holde til al den støj længere.
senses.example_translation: I can't stand all that noise anymore.

senses.example: Hun holdt ved med at øve sig hver dag.
senses.example_translation: She kept practicing every day.

senses.text: to become a new person (change for the better)
senses.example: Efter rejsen føler jeg, at jeg er blevet et nyt menneske.
senses.example_translation: After the trip, I feel like I've become a new person.

senses.example: Hun så sig tilbage, før hun gik ind i huset.
senses.example_translation: She looked back before entering the house.

senses.example: Hans erfaring vejer op for den manglende uddannelse.
senses.example_translation: His experience makes up for the lack of education.

senses.example: Jeg skrev ned hvad læreren sagde.
senses.example_translation: I wrote down what the teacher said.

senses.example: Han kom til penge, da hans onkel døde.
senses.example_translation: He came into money when his uncle died.

senses.example: Jeg tror, hun klarer den uden hjælp.
senses.example_translation: I think she can handle it without help.

senses.example: Det regner nu, men det klarer op senere.
senses.example_translation: It is raining now, but it will clear up later.

senses.example: Han er tro mod sine venner.
senses.example_translation: He is faithful to his friends.

senses.example: Jeg lægger mig ned på sofaen efter arbejde.
senses.example_translation: I lie down on the couch after work.

senses.example: Jeg begynder med at tage opvasken.
senses.example_translation: I start by doing the dishes.

senses.example: Skibet gik på grund nær havnen.
senses.example_translation: The ship ran aground near the harbour.

senses.example: Vi blev hjemme på grund af at det regnede.
senses.example_translation: We stayed at home because it was raining.

senses.example: Vi gjorde kål på resterne fra i går.
senses.example_translation: We finished off yesterday's leftovers.

senses.example: De to virksomheder gik sammen om et nyt projekt.
senses.example_translation: The two companies joined forces on a new project.
